about.title: A veteran-owned Houston HVAC company built on honest service
text: Texas Strong Mechanical is a veteran-owned, owner-led HVAC company based in Humble, serving homeowners, churches, property managers and local businesses across Greater Houston. Built on honest diagnostics, fair value and personal service, we give customers practical repair, maintenance, replacement and financing options without unnecessary pressure.

Before starting Texas Strong Mechanical, our owner worked around some of the larger air-conditioning companies in Houston. He often met homeowners who needed HVAC repair or replacement but could not move forward because the price was out of reach. Those experiences shaped the mission behind the company: professional HVAC service on a more personal and affordable scale.

We believe customers deserve to understand what is happening with their system before approving work. Our licensed and insured team explains the issue clearly, provides upfront recommendations, and helps each customer choose the best next step for their comfort, budget and long-term system performance.
Our team works on all major HVAC brands and operates under Texas HVAC license TACLA00126275E. Eligible HVAC repairs are backed by a 1-year parts and labor warranty.

faqs.q: Do you offer same-day AC repair in Houston?
faqs.a: Yes. We prioritize all service calls and aim for same-day delivery on air conditioning repair requests, typically responding within hours.

faqs.q: How much does an AC service call cost?
faqs.a: Residential diagnostic is $89.95 and commercial diagnostic is $199.00 plus tax. Minor repairs generally range from $150 to $350, and we provide a full quote before any work is started.
Eligible AC repairs are backed by a 1-year parts and labor warranty.
Yes. We are fully state-licensed under Texas HVAC license TACLA00126275E, and insured.

faqs.q: Should I repair or replace my older AC unit?
faqs.a: If your unit is over 10 to 12 years old and repairs are frequent, replacement might be more cost-effective. We always assess the system and offer the most logical repair options first.

faqs.q: Do you offer emergency HVAC service after hours?
faqs.a: Yes, we are available 24/7 for emergency AC and heating repairs, and we respond quickly during extreme Houston weather.

faqs.q: What HVAC brands do you service and install?
faqs.a: We service all major manufacturers, including Trane, Carrier, Lennox and Goodman. Our technicians are trained to handle the technical requirements of high-efficiency cooling and heating systems.

faqs.q: How often should I have my AC system serviced?
faqs.a: We recommend professional maintenance at least once a year, ideally in the spring. Regular tune-ups prevent most common failures and help maintain your manufacturer's warranty coverage.

faqs.q: Can you help with indoor air quality and allergies?
faqs.a: Yes. Our air duct cleaning and filtration services remove dust, pet dander and allergens from the home, which improves breathing conditions and the system's efficiency.

faqs.q: Do you provide HVAC services for commercial properties?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer commercial HVAC repair, maintenance and installation for small businesses and churches, and we understand the cooling loads of commercial spaces in Greater Houston.

faqs.q: Do you charge for an estimate?
faqs.a: No. Estimates are free, and you can book a free inspection before you decide on anything. For a large facility we will come out and survey the site at no cost so the quote is exact.

faqs.q: My system still runs on R-22 freon. Can you upgrade it?
faqs.a: Yes. The EPA phased out R-22, so we assess which refrigerant your system uses and upgrade it to a newer, environmentally safe replacement such as R407c or MO99. We can do it now or help you plan for it.

faqs.q: What comes with a new system installation?
faqs.a: A complimentary thermostat and a 1-year labor warranty. Air conditioning and heat pump installations include a smart thermostat, furnace installations a programmable one.

faqs.q: Some rooms never cool properly. Is that the air conditioner?
faqs.a: Often it is the ductwork rather than the equipment. We measure airflow and temperatures, then resize the duct runs and balance the air instead of selling you a bigger system.

faqs.q: Do you work with churches and property managers on maintenance?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer special non-profit rates on annual maintenance agreements for worship centers, and bulk pricing for property management firms with 20 or more units under contract.

faqs.q: Will I pay extra for an after-hours call?
faqs.a: Members do not. There are no overtime charges on member work, and members reach a live 24/7 call center rather than an answering service.
